remarks: Welcome to this spacious and charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom ranch-style condo located on the second floor of the desirable Fairlawn complex in Stamford. Bursting with potential, this home offers the perfect opportunity to bring your creative vision and make it your dream space. The eat-in kitchen provides a cozy setting for meals, while the private balcony you to relax and enjoy some quiet moments outdoors. This unit includes up to two reserved parking spaces, a small storage area for added convenience, and nearby access to shared laundry facilities. The complex is pet-friendly, making it a great choice for animal lovers. The HOA covers heat, hot water, snow removal, lawn care, shoveling, parking, and trash, simplifying your lifestyle and allowing you to focus on what matters most. Conveniently located near transportation, restaurants, and shopping, this condo offers an unbeatable combination of value, location, and potential. Sold "As Is," this is your chance to create the home you've always wanted. Don't miss this opportunity to make it yours!
